plan.problem: GPU image reuse has no end-to-end training benefit. Establish where current Metal training waits before selecting a kernel change.
plan.change: Optional synchronized wall-time measurement of forward, loss construction, backward, and update/housekeeping/noise. Profile only zero-based iterations 210..219,1210..1219,2610..2619; same binary with profiler disabled is baseline.
plan.acceptance: Check trace coverage and positive finite stage measurements; compare profiler-off/on quality and total cost. Times include host work, fusion drain and GPU synchronization; do not call them pure kernel GPU times or normal throughput percentages.
plan.profile_summary: Keep all raw samples. Exclude the first two samples of each ten-step window from steady-window summaries to allow changed fusion graphs to warm up. Report each window separately; do not treat synchronized stage shares as normal throughput shares.

raw_runs.measurement: adapter training, evaluation and export; excludes SfM and input copy

timing_scope: Serial adapter training/evaluation/export, including per-process first image cache population. Excludes SfM and input copy; OS and driver caches not flushed. Same instrumented binary in both variants.
quality_scope: Frozen shared-camera geometry per scene, every eighth photo excluded from training but used in SfM; all scores recomputed at long edge 512. Two repeats do not establish general gains.
profile_scope: Synchronized host wall time ending in Fusion drain and GPU completion. Includes host submission, fusion work and potentially overlapping prefetch uploads. Update includes housekeeping, optimizer and position noise. Excludes input-fetch waiting, initial drain, refinement, evaluation, export and logging. Not hardware GPU timestamps; do not infer normal throughput shares.

references.name: Faster-GS
references.relevance: Implementation-level optimizations and fused SSIM in evaluation motivate measuring local stages before changing kernels. Paper speedups are not local measurements.

references.name: fused-ssim
references.relevance: Official README lists fused statistics and Metal/MPS support. This PyTorch extension is not directly interchangeable with Brush Burn/Wgpu; no code has been copied or installed.

decision: Use stage profiling to guide future work; do not enable synchronization or claim a throughput gain. Candidate synchronized traces show backward grows with splat count and is the largest measured stage in all windows; profiling changes scheduling and is not a normal run.
